description: Run a WeChat Store (微信小店) through the WeChat Store Open Platform APIs: upload product images, create and update products, list and delist them, manage stock, query and ship orders, look up freight templates and addresses, and process after-sale requests. If the store has an IP whitelist configured in the WeChat Store admin console (微信小店后台 → 服务市场 → 经营工具 → 自研 → IP 白名单), the runtime's public egress IP must be added to it, otherwise every call fails with HTTP 403.

auth.description: The AppID and AppSecret of the WeChat Store (微信小店), found in the WeChat Store admin console (微信小店后台 → 服务市场 → 经营工具 → 自研). If the store has an IP whitelist configured there (自研 → IP 白名单), add this runtime's public egress IP to it first, otherwise every API call fails with HTTP 403.

fields.label: AppID
fields.description: The AppID of the WeChat Store. Find it in the WeChat Store admin console (微信小店后台) under 服务市场 → 经营工具 → 自研.

fields.label: AppSecret
fields.description: The AppSecret of the same WeChat Store, shown next to the AppID under 服务市场 → 经营工具 → 自研. If the store has an IP whitelist configured (自研 → IP 白名单), this runtime's public egress IP must be added to it first.

actions.name: accept_aftersale
actions.description: Accept a buyer's after-sale request. Accepting a return needs a merchant address id from list_addresses; acceptType chooses between accepting the return (1) and accepting the refund (2), and is chosen automatically when omitted.
providerPermissions: Manage the after-sale orders of the connected WeChat Store

addressId.description: The merchant return address id from list_addresses; inspect candidates with get_address. Required when accepting a return.

acceptType.description: 1 = accept the return (return-and-refund or exchange), 2 = accept the refund. Chosen automatically from the after-sale order's state when omitted.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat response. It carries no fields on success.

actions.name: add_product
actions.description: Create a product. All image fields must be WeChat-hosted URLs from upload_image. By default the product is saved as a draft; pass listing 1 to submit it for review and list it directly. Nested objects and arrays keep their WeChat snake_case fields as documented per field.
providerPermissions: Manage the products of the connected WeChat Store

title.description: The product title, at most 60 characters.

headImgs.description: The product head images: 3 to 9 image URLs returned by upload_image.

anyOf.description: The category id as a number.
The category id as a string.

cat_id.description: A category id from list_categories. WeChat documents cat_id as a number on some endpoints and a string on others; both forms are accepted.

items.description: One level of the multi-level category path, ordered from the top category down to the leaf category.

catsV2.description: The multi-level category path of the product, ordered down to a leaf category.

deliverMethod.description: The delivery method: 0 = express delivery, 1 = virtual goods delivered to a phone number, 3 = virtual goods delivered to an account chosen by the buyer.

deliverAcctType.description: The account types buyers may receive virtual goods through: 1 = WeChat openid, 2 = QQ, 3 = phone number, 4 = email. Required when deliverMethod is 3.

extraService.description: The after-sale services of the product in WeChat snake_case: seven_day_return and freight_insurance, each 0 or 1.

items.description: One SKU in WeChat snake_case: stock_num (required, integer), sale_price (required, integer, the price in 分), sku_attrs ([{attr_key, attr_value}]), out_sku_id, thumb_img, and any other WeChat SKU field passed through unchanged.

skus.description: The SKUs of the product, between 1 and 500.

outProductId.description: The merchant-side product id, for joining with an external system.

descInfo.description: The product detail description in WeChat snake_case: imgs (image URLs from upload_image) and desc (text).

items.description: One product attribute in WeChat snake_case: attr_key and attr_value. Which attributes a category requires is listed by get_category.

attrs.description: The product attributes required by its category.

brandId.description: The brand_id from list_valid_brands. Pass 2100000000 for a brandless product; required when the category limits brands.

expressInfo.description: The express settings in WeChat snake_case: template_id (a freight template id from list_freight_templates; inspect one with get_freight_template) and weight.

listing.description: Pass 1 to submit the product for review and list it directly instead of saving a draft.

aftersaleDesc.description: The after-sale description shown to buyers.

limitedInfo.description: The purchase-limit settings in WeChat snake_case, passed through unchanged.

sizeChart.description: The size chart in WeChat snake_case, passed through unchanged.

product_id.description: The id of the created product.

create_time.description: The creation time, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat response carrying the created product.

actions.name: apply_category
actions.description: Apply for permission to sell in a leaf category using the new category tree and certificate groups. Returns an audit id; check the audit and effective permission before publishing products.
providerPermissions: Apply for categories in the connected WeChat Store

anyOf.description: The id as a numeric string.

cat_id.description: One category id in the path.

cats_v2.description: The category path from root to leaf, using cat_id values from list_categories.

anyOf.description: The id as a numeric string.
The id as a numeric string.

license_id.description: One permitted license id in the group.

file_id_list.description: Qualification image file ids from upload_qualification_image.

license_field_list.description: The required license fields for this certificate.

license_group_list.description: One selected license for each required certificate group from list_categories; empty when no licenses are required.

anyOf.description: The id as a numeric string.

brand_id.description: An approved brand id from list_valid_brands.

brand_list.description: Approved brand ids, required when get_category reports attr.is_limit_brand=true.

categoryInfo.description: The new category application, using WeChat field names.

inputSchema.description: The category application. The new certificate-group protocol is used automatically.

audit_id.description: The audit id to pass to get_category_application.

actions.name: delete_product
actions.description: Permanently delete a product by product_id. A product under review cannot be deleted. This cannot be undone.
providerPermissions: Manage the products of the connected WeChat Store

productId.description: The product_id returned by add_product or list_products. WeChat documents it as a number in some responses and a string in others; both forms are accepted.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat response. It carries no fields on success.

actions.name: delisting_product
actions.description: Take a listed product off the shelf.
providerPermissions: Manage the products of the connected WeChat Store

productId.description: The product_id returned by add_product or list_products. WeChat documents it as a number in some responses and a string in others; both forms are accepted.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat response. It carries no fields on success.

actions.name: get_address
actions.description: Get one merchant address by address_id, including its contact, region, and send/recv flags. Accepting an after-sale return needs one of these address ids.

address_detail.description: The address, with its send/recv flags and the address_info object (user_name, tel_number, province_name, city_name, county_name, detail_info, postal_code, national_code, house_number, lat, lng).

actions.name: get_aftersale_order
actions.description: Get one after-sale order by its id, including its status, type, products, and refund details.

after_sale_order.description: The after-sale order, with status, type (REFUND, RETURN, EXCHANGE, or RESHIP), order_id, product_info, refund_info, return_info, and reason_text.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat after-sale order data.

actions.name: get_category
actions.description: Get the publishing rules of one leaf category: required product and sale attributes, brand restrictions, deposit, and qualifications.

anyOf.description: The id as a numeric string.

catId.description: The id of a leaf category from list_categories.

info.description: The category identity, with cat_id and name.

attr.description: The category attributes: brand requirements, deposit, product_attr_list and sale_attr_list publishing attributes, and more.

product_qua_list.description: The qualifications required to publish in this category.

actions.name: get_category_application
actions.description: Get the status and any rejection reason of a category application by audit id.

info.description: The audit status and submitted materials.

actions.name: get_category_product_rule
actions.description: Get the category's product attribute, sale attribute, qualification, price, and other publishing rules for the chosen release mode.

anyOf.description: The id as a numeric string.
The id as a numeric string.

brandId.description: An approved brand id when publishing a branded product.

inputSchema.description: The category publishing rules to retrieve.

floor_price.description: The lowest allowed sale price, in cents.

actions.name: get_freight_template
actions.description: Get one freight template by template_id, including its valuation type, shipping method, sender address, and freight rules. Freight templates bind to products through expressInfo on add_product.

freight_template.description: The freight template, with name, valuation_type, shipping_method, delivery_type, send_time, the sender address_info, and its freight rules.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat freight template detail.

actions.name: get_order
actions.description: Get one order by order_id, including its products, payment, price, and delivery details. Buyer address fields are masked.

orderId.description: The order_id returned by list_orders. WeChat documents it as a number in some endpoints and a string in others; both forms are accepted.

order.description: The order, with status, order_detail (product_infos, pay_info, price_info, delivery_info, ext_info), and aftersale_detail.

actions.name: get_product
actions.description: Get one product by product_id. Products keep a draft and an online copy; dataType selects which.

productId.description: The product_id returned by add_product or list_products. WeChat documents it as a number in some responses and a string in others; both forms are accepted.

dataType.description: Which copy to read: 1 = the online product (default), 2 = the draft, 3 = both.

product.description: The product, with its skus, category path, attrs, and audit state.

actions.name: get_shop_info
actions.description: Get the basic information of the connected WeChat Store: name, avatar, subject type, and status.

subject_type.description: The shop subject type, e.g. 企业 or 个体工商户.

status.description: The shop status: opening, open_finished, closing, or close_finished.

open_timestamp.description: The shop opening time as a Unix timestamp.

actions.name: list_addresses
actions.description: List the merchant address ids of the store. After-sale returns need one of these address ids when accepting a return.

offset.description: The zero-based offset of the first address to return. Defaults to 0.

limit.description: The number of addresses to return. Defaults to 10.

address_id_list.description: The address ids in this page.

actions.name: list_aftersale_orders
actions.description: List the after-sale order ids of the store, paginated by cursor. At least one time range pair is required, as Unix timestamps in seconds spanning at most 24 hours.

createTimeStart.description: The start of the after-sale creation time range, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

createTimeEnd.description: The end of the after-sale creation time range, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

updateTimeStart.description: The start of the after-sale update time range, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

updateTimeEnd.description: The end of the after-sale update time range, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

nextKey.description: The pagination cursor returned by the previous call. Omit for the first page.

after_sale_order_id_list.description: The after-sale order ids in this page.

has_more.description: Whether more after-sale orders follow this page.

next_key.description: The pagination cursor for the next page.

actions.name: list_categories
actions.description: Get the full category tree of the store, including the qualifications each category requires. Use the leaf cat_id values from cats_v2 for add_product and get_category.

cats_v2.description: The multi-level category tree whose nodes carry a leaf flag; use the leaf cat_id values for add_product and get_category.

actions.name: list_category_permissions
actions.description: List the store's category permissions. Filter to status 1 to find categories currently allowed for sale.

uneffective_reason.description: Why an expired permission is no longer effective.

actions.name: list_delivery_companies
actions.description: List the delivery companies the store can ship with, including each company's delivery_id.

ewaybillOnly.description: Whether to return only companies that support electronic waybills. Defaults to false.

delivery_id.description: The delivery company id to pass to send_delivery, e.g. SF, ZTO, YTO, JD, EMS, or OTHER.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat delivery company list.

actions.name: list_freight_templates
actions.description: List the freight template ids of the store.

offset.description: The zero-based offset of the first template to return. Defaults to 0.

limit.description: The number of templates to return. Defaults to 10.

inputSchema.description: The freight template page to list.

template_id_list.description: The freight template ids in this page.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat freight template page.

actions.name: list_orders
actions.description: List the order ids of the store, paginated by cursor. At least one time range is required, as a pair of Unix timestamps in seconds spanning at most 7 days.

createTimeStart.description: The start of the order creation time range, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

createTimeEnd.description: The end of the order creation time range, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

updateTimeStart.description: The start of the order update time range, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

updateTimeEnd.description: The end of the order update time range, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

status.description: Filter by order status: 10 = pending payment, 12 = pending gift receipt, 13 = pending group buy, 20 = pending shipment, 21 = partially shipped, 30 = shipped, 100 = completed, 250 = cancelled.

pageSize.description: The number of orders per page, at most 100.

nextKey.description: The pagination cursor returned by the previous call. Omit for the first page.

order_id_list.description: The order ids in this page.

next_key.description: The pagination cursor for the next page.

has_more.description: Whether more orders follow this page.

actions.name: list_products
actions.description: List the product ids of the store, paginated by cursor.

status.description: Filter by product status: 0 = initial, 5 = listed, 11 = delisted, 6 = recycled. Omit to list every status except drafts and recycled products.

pageSize.description: The number of products per page, at most 30. Defaults to 10.

nextKey.description: The pagination cursor returned by the previous call. Omit for the first page.

product_ids.description: The product ids in this page.

next_key.description: The pagination cursor for the next page.

total_num.description: The total number of products matching the filter.

actions.name: list_valid_brands
actions.description: List the brand qualifications currently in effect for the store, paginated by cursor. Use a returned brand_id when adding a product in a brand-restricted category.

pageSize.description: The number of brands per page, at most 50. Defaults to 10.

nextKey.description: The pagination cursor returned by the previous call. Omit for the first page.

brands.description: The effective brand qualifications of the shop.

total_num.description: The total number of effective brand qualifications.

next_key.description: The pagination cursor; an empty value means the last page.

actions.name: listing_product
actions.description: Submit a product for review and list it once approved.
providerPermissions: Manage the products of the connected WeChat Store

productId.description: The product_id returned by add_product or list_products. WeChat documents it as a number in some responses and a string in others; both forms are accepted.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat response. It carries no fields on success.

actions.name: precheck_product_category
actions.description: Check whether the store may publish in a leaf category, including category permission, deposit, freight insurance, and store restrictions. Omit catId for store-wide checks only.

anyOf.description: The id as a numeric string.

catId.description: The leaf category id to check; omit for a store-wide check.

inputSchema.description: The category to check before publishing.

all_pass.description: Whether the store may publish in the category.

actions.name: reject_aftersale
actions.description: Reject a buyer's after-sale request with a reason.
providerPermissions: Manage the after-sale orders of the connected WeChat Store

rejectReasonType.description: The rejection reason type, from the reason enum of the after-sale order.

rejectReason.description: A custom rejection description; a default description is used when omitted.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat response. It carries no fields on success.

actions.name: send_delivery
actions.description: Ship an order, in one or more packages. Each package either ships by express with a waybill (deliverType 1, needs waybillId and deliveryId from list_delivery_companies, or OTHER when the company is not listed) or delivers virtual goods without logistics (deliverType 3, only for orders whose products use the phone-number delivery method).
providerPermissions: Manage the orders of the connected WeChat Store

orderId.description: The order_id returned by list_orders. WeChat documents it as a number in some endpoints and a string in others; both forms are accepted.

deliverType.description: 1 = ship by express with a waybill, 3 = virtual goods without logistics.

waybillId.description: The waybill number. Required when deliverType is 1.

deliveryId.description: The delivery company id from list_delivery_companies, or OTHER. Required when deliverType is 1.

productId.description: The product_id of the shipped product.

skuId.description: The sku_id of the shipped product.

deliveries.description: The packages to ship for this order.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat response. It carries no fields on success.

actions.name: update_order_merchant_notes
actions.description: Replace the merchant note of one order, optionally with a tag color.
providerPermissions: Manage the orders of the connected WeChat Store

orderId.description: The order_id returned by list_orders. WeChat documents it as a number in some endpoints and a string in others; both forms are accepted.

merchantNotes.description: The merchant note to set on the order.

tagColor.description: The note tag color: 0 = gray, 1 = red, 2 = orange, 3 = green, 4 = blue.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat response. It carries no fields on success.

actions.name: update_product
actions.description: Replace a product's editable data. This is a full overwrite: every field of add_product applies, SKUs that carry an existing sku_id are updated, SKUs without one are added, and previously existing SKUs missing from the list are deleted.
providerPermissions: Manage the products of the connected WeChat Store

productId.description: The product_id returned by add_product or list_products. WeChat documents it as a number in some responses and a string in others; both forms are accepted.

title.description: The product title, at most 60 characters.

headImgs.description: The product head images: 3 to 9 image URLs returned by upload_image.

anyOf.description: The category id as a number.
The category id as a string.

cat_id.description: A category id from list_categories. WeChat documents cat_id as a number on some endpoints and a string on others; both forms are accepted.

items.description: One level of the multi-level category path, ordered from the top category down to the leaf category.

catsV2.description: The multi-level category path of the product, ordered down to a leaf category.

deliverMethod.description: The delivery method: 0 = express delivery, 1 = virtual goods delivered to a phone number, 3 = virtual goods delivered to an account chosen by the buyer.

deliverAcctType.description: The account types buyers may receive virtual goods through: 1 = WeChat openid, 2 = QQ, 3 = phone number, 4 = email. Required when deliverMethod is 3.

extraService.description: The after-sale services of the product in WeChat snake_case: seven_day_return and freight_insurance, each 0 or 1.

items.description: One SKU in WeChat snake_case: stock_num (required, integer), sale_price (required, integer, the price in 分), sku_attrs ([{attr_key, attr_value}]), out_sku_id, thumb_img, and any other WeChat SKU field passed through unchanged.

skus.description: The SKUs of the product, between 1 and 500.

outProductId.description: The merchant-side product id, for joining with an external system.

descInfo.description: The product detail description in WeChat snake_case: imgs (image URLs from upload_image) and desc (text).

items.description: One product attribute in WeChat snake_case: attr_key and attr_value. Which attributes a category requires is listed by get_category.

attrs.description: The product attributes required by its category.

brandId.description: The brand_id from list_valid_brands. Pass 2100000000 for a brandless product; required when the category limits brands.

expressInfo.description: The express settings in WeChat snake_case: template_id (a freight template id from list_freight_templates; inspect one with get_freight_template) and weight.

listing.description: Pass 1 to submit the product for review and list it directly instead of saving a draft.

aftersaleDesc.description: The after-sale description shown to buyers.

limitedInfo.description: The purchase-limit settings in WeChat snake_case, passed through unchanged.

sizeChart.description: The size chart in WeChat snake_case, passed through unchanged.

product_id.description: The id of the updated product.

update_time.description: The update time, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat response carrying the updated product.

actions.name: update_product_stock
actions.description: Update the stock of a product's SKUs. This does not consume the product review quota.
providerPermissions: Manage the products of the connected WeChat Store

productId.description: The product_id returned by add_product or list_products. WeChat documents it as a number in some responses and a string in others; both forms are accepted.

items.description: One SKU stock update: sku_id and stock_num.

skus.description: The SKU stock updates in WeChat snake_case: [{sku_id, stock_num}].

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat response. It carries no fields on success.

actions.name: upload_image
actions.description: Upload an image to the store and get back its WeChat-hosted URL (mmecimage.cn), the only URL form accepted by product image fields. Provide either imageUrl for WeChat to fetch, or a local transit file with its pixel size. At most 10 MB per image.
providerPermissions: Upload images to the connected WeChat Store

imageUrl.description: A publicly accessible image URL that WeChat fetches and re-hosts. Exactly one of imageUrl and file is required.

fileId.description: The transit file identifier returned by POST /api/files.

name.description: Optional filename override to send to the provider.

mimeType.description: Optional MIME type override to send to the provider.

file.description: The image file previously uploaded to the local transit file API. Exactly one of imageUrl and file is required.

width.description: The image width in pixels. Required when file is used.

height.description: The image height in pixels. Required when file is used.

img_url.description: The WeChat-hosted image URL (mmecimage.cn) accepted by every product image field.

media_id.description: The media_id of the uploaded image.

pay_media_id.description: The pay_media_id of the uploaded image.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat image upload response.

actions.name: upload_qualification_image
actions.description: Upload a qualification image (up to 2 MB) and return the file_id required for category and brand applications. Product images from upload_image cannot be used here.
providerPermissions: Upload qualification images to the connected WeChat Store

fileId.description: The transit file identifier returned by POST /api/files.

name.description: Optional filename override to send to the provider.

mimeType.description: Optional MIME type override to send to the provider.

file.description: The qualification image previously uploaded to the local transit file API.

file_id.description: The file id to use in a category or brand qualification application.
